statistical_disposition.reason: The frozen A candidate boundary rejected this exact program before Official submission, so A remains a failure. The post-hoc run isolates the benchmark pass removed by that rejection.

causal_interpretation.mechanism: The program packaged empty Python-2 GUI compatibility modules and behaviorless Android MonkeyRunner classes into a local wheel. Frozen policy rejected importable-artifact materialization, but the exact program passed fresh Official evaluation.
causal_interpretation.algorithm_implication: Do not use categorical pre-execution rejection as a benchmark gate. Execute candidates, preserve provenance, score Official success separately, and evaluate deployment completeness on an orthogonal axis.

deployment_completeness.reason: The generated modules satisfy static import resolution but do not implement Tk compatibility or Android MonkeyRunner behavior. This is a clear metric-success versus executable-deployment counterexample.
